diagram.name: Chart of Accounts Service DB Architecture

mxCell.value: coa_accounts ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) tenant_id (varchar, indexed) code (varchar, indexed) name (varchar) account_type (varchar: asset/liability/equity/revenue/expense) category (varchar) sub_category (varchar) parent_id (FK -> coa_accounts.id, self-ref) normal_balance (varchar: debit/credit) level (int) is_active (bool) is_system_account (bool) currency (varchar) description (text) tb_account_id (varchar, nullable - TigerBeetle) created_at / updated_at UNIQUE(tenant_id, code)

journal_entries ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) tenant_id (varchar, indexed) date (date, indexed) description (varchar) reference (varchar) entry_type (varchar: manual/system/adjustment) period_id (FK -> accounting_periods) posted_by (varchar) status (varchar: draft/posted/reversed) reversal_of_id (FK -> journal_entries, nullable) total_debit / total_credit (bigint) metadata (JSONB) created_at / updated_at

journal_entry_lines ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) entry_id (FK -> journal_entries.id) account_id (FK -> coa_accounts.id) description (varchar) debit_amount (bigint) credit_amount (bigint) currency (varchar) line_number (int) created_at

accounting_periods ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) tenant_id (varchar, indexed) name (varchar) period_type (varchar: monthly/quarterly/annual) start_date / end_date (date) status (varchar: open/closed/locked) closed_by / closed_at created_at

approval_workflows ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) tenant_id (varchar) workflow_name (varchar) entity_type (varchar: journal_entry/account) approval_type (varchar: sequential/parallel) is_active (bool) created_at

approval_requests ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) workflow_id (FK -> approval_workflows) tenant_id (varchar) entity_id (varchar) entity_type (varchar) requested_by (varchar) status (varchar: pending/approved/rejected) current_step (int) metadata (JSONB) created_at / updated_at
account_templates ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) template_name (varchar) description (text) industry (varchar: banking/microfinance/...) accounts (JSONB array) is_system (bool) created_at

audit_log ---------------------- id (PK, UUID) tenant_id (varchar, indexed) entity_type / entity_id (varchar) action (varchar) performed_by (varchar) changes (JSONB) ip_address (varchar) performed_at (timestamp)
